x: What is Dry Eye? Dry eye syndrome (DES) is caused by a lack of tears or poor quality tears, leading to irritation and discomfort in the eyes. Dry eye syndrome can be annoying and, left untreated, severe cases can damage the surface of the eye and even lead to vision loss. That's why it's so important to understand what causes DES and to treat it. What Causes Dry Eye Syndrome? Dry eye syndrome can be caused by aging, certain medications and medical conditions, and excessive screen time (we blink less when staring at a digital screen). Other causes include vision correction surgery, and smoking.
